messages:
maya: heads-up: hit a weird OOM on prod serving for a 64k-step long convo. not typical seq len for this model but reproduces locally with a stress harness :frowning:
sam: can you paste the logs / an excerpt? is this the activation allocator or logits scratchpad blowing up?
maya: logs point to attempted alloc of ~1.2GB for logits_scratchpad on CUDA stream 2 right after a KV cache load. stack trace points to workspace_reserve -> tensor_pool::acquire
maya: repro steps (local):

```
# run the stress harness
./serve_bench --model redwood-medium --batch 1 --seq 81920 --kv-warmup 3 --iters 5
```
`--seq 81920` meaning long decoding trace; hits OOM inside serve runtime in ~3rd iter

```
E cuda_alloc: OOM attempting 1228800000 bytes in logits_scratchpad
```
eli: hmm that sequence implies our scratchpad sizing multiplies by max(seq, decode_chunk) and we have no soft cap per-request. default policy is global pool with LRU free. That can cause a single request to hoard big buffers.
sam: does the pool currently carve by dtype/shape buckets or is it a monotonic allocator? iirc we used a simple freelist per size-class.
maya: freelist per size-class. problem is logits vs activations share same pool namespace; logits temporary buffers are often much larger for long seqs and then hold onto them for awhile, preventing reuse for smaller activations.
alex: proposed fix: split pools by usage class: {activations, logits, scratchpad-per-stream}. also add per-request hard cap + async eviction for >X ms idle buffers.
rashmi: agree with split. also we should ensure per-stream scratchpads are reused across requests on same CUDA stream to avoid cross-stream pinning costs.
eli: implementation notes: 
- introduce PoolKind enum (ACT, LOGIT, SCRATCH_STREAM)
- keep bucketed freelist per (PoolKind, size_class)
- when acquiring, if exact bucket empty, try lower bucket, else allocate up to per-kind hard_cap (configurable)
- eviction thread that frees oldest idle buffers when global mem pressure > threshold

sam: perf-bot just posted alloc traces earlier today, we can correlate. perf-bot: attach trace id perf/477b
perf-bot: trace perf/477b: peak_gpu_mem: 41.2GB, logs_buffered: 2.1GB, avg_alloc_time: 210us
maya: thanks, linking that trace to the repro run. If we split pools and add hard cap, estimated mem drop ~20-30% for worst-case sequences from quick simulation.
alex: also consider workspace sizing heuristic: use 1.25 * median(seq_lengths_seen) instead of max(seq) to size per-request workspace, with a fallback for tail requests that requests ephemeral allocations (tries to reuse but can fail gracefully).
rashmi: important: add metrics we can alert on: pool_evictions/sec, pool_steals (when we borrow from other kind), large-alloc-fails, per-kind utilization pct.
eli: for correctness, ensure tensors that are reused don't carry stale padding values — zero on acquire might add cost; instead mark allocations as uninitialized but ensure usage writes before read. add a debug-mode memset to catch bugs.
maya: plan: I'll prototype split pools + eviction in a branch and run the stress harness + perf/477b trace. target: small change, feature-flag default off, test coverage for reuse correctness.
sam: put a docstring in the allocator code describing semantics: acquire may return larger buffer; caller must not assume zeroed; caller can request memset if needed.
eli: code snippet for acquire heuristic to try in patch:

```
Buffer* acquire(kind, size) {
  bucket = size_class(size);
  if (bucket.has()) return bucket.pop();
  // try smaller
  for (b in smaller_buckets) if (b.has()) return b.pop();
  if (current_kind_usage + size <= per_kind_hard_cap) return alloc(size);
  // evict oldest idle across this kind
  evict_oldest(kind);
  if (current_kind_usage + size <= per_kind_hard_cap) return alloc(size);
  return null; // caller handles OOM fallback
}
```

alex: looks good. one more: when release, tag buffer with last_used_ts so eviction can pick LRU.
maya: I'll push branch and share link. would love one of you to review since it touches the allocator.
rashmi: I'll take first pass on tests and metrics integration. also will add regression job that runs long-seq harness weekly.
sam: thanks — once branch lands, let's enable feature flag in staging and run 24h soak with perf traces.
maya: ack. action items pinned: maya -> prototype split pools; rashmi -> tests + metrics; sam -> rollout plan + staging soak; eli/alex -> quick review. :+1:
sam: thanks folks, this should reduce OOM hotspots and make memory behaviour more predictable. :eyes:
